verdict.rationale: IRCC runs online application portals with accounts, including representative and employer access, so a buyer could fairly ask whether an AI agent can be given delegated, scoped access. That makes the axis applicable. However, nothing in the evidence documents API credentials of any kind, let alone scoped or least-privilege ones. The mention of representative accounts covers delegated human access, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
